seo.homeDescription: Axelkod AB in Mölndal, Sweden, supplies parts for heavy vehicles, builds software and advises on cyber security. Get in touch to learn more.
seo.privacyDescription: How Axelkod AB handles personal data sent through the contact form.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Tell us briefly what you need and we'll be in touch.
contact.responseFallback: We get back to you within 1–2 business days.

footer.tagline: Parts, code and security from Mölndal.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.text: Axelkod AB, Mölndal, Sweden, is the controller of the personal data sent through the contact form on this website.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.text: Name, email address, phone number (optional), company (optional), your area of interest and your message. The website uses no cookies, no analytics and no third-party services.

sections.title: Why
sections.text: The data is used only to answer your enquiry. The legal basis is your consent, which you give when you submit the form.

sections.title: Where it is stored
sections.text: Messages are stored in a canister (a program with its own storage) on the Internet Computer, a decentralised network whose servers are run by independent operators. Only authorised people at Axelkod can read them. We send no emails and share the data with no one.

sections.title: How long
sections.text: Messages are deleted automatically after {months} months.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can at any time ask what data we hold about you, have it corrected or deleted, or withdraw your consent. Contact us through the form and we will help. You also have the right to complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY).
